$comment: The invented people of Krizaka's products — fictional adults generated by Orazaka (image-generation Studio, FLUX.2 [klein] 4B, Apache-2.0) on one Mac, signed in as Eric; owned by Krizaka. One face = one persona = one product (tests/people.test.mjs). Files: site/people/<product>/ on the CDN (lib/cdn.ts). `prompt` + `seed` + `size` + `model` remake an image. Credits: lib/people.credits.md.

people.name: Camille Roy
people.prompt: A 33-year-old Black woman, a dance teacher, natural curly hair pulled up in a high puff, deep brown skin, wearing a plain mustard-yellow top. Editorial head-and-shoulders portrait photograph, looking into the camera with a calm, friendly expression. Even soft daylight from a large window on the left, a plain light warm-grey seamless studio backdrop, 85mm lens at f/2.8, sharp eyes, natural skin texture with pores and small imperfections, no retouching, plain clothing without any print. Square composition, face centred in the upper half, shoulders visible. An ordinary fictional person, not a celebrity and not a fashion model. No text, no lettering, no logos.
